parameters.name: ImageUrl
parameters.description: The URL of the input image. We recommend that you use an Object Storage Service (OSS) URL in the China (Shanghai) region. If the file is stored locally or the OSS URL is not in the China (Shanghai) region, see [File URL processing](~~155645~~).

parameters.name: OutputFormat
parameters.description: The storage format of the output image. Valid values: `png`, `jpg`, and `bmp`. Default value: `png`.

parameters.name: OutputQuality
parameters.description: The quality factor of the output image. A larger value indicates higher quality. Valid values: \[30,100]. Default value: 95. This parameter takes effect only when `outputFormat` is set to `jpg`.

parameters.name: Scale
parameters.description: The image upscaling factor. Valid values: 1, 2, 3, and 4. Default value: 2.

parameters.name: UserData
parameters.description: This parameter is a reserved field. You do not need to specify this parameter.
